text:
tilt-corp: Hey team — we just tried to redeem the enterprise voucher (CODE: TLT-ENTER-42) and it credited our Hosted balance instead of provisioning Dedicated capacity. customer stuck waiting for dedicated trial slot.

kristen-support: Ugh, sorry about that. Can you paste the tenant id and the CLI command you used?

tilt-corp: Tenant ID: tenant-tilt-9f2. Redeem command we ran (support portal UI also used):
```
rw grant apply --code TLT-ENTER-42 --tenant tenant-tilt-9f2 --target dedicated
```
Response from UI said "Grant applied": success, but backend shows hosted credit + Hosted SKU in billing console.

devon-billing: Looking. I can see a grant record but target_sku="HOSTED_BASIC" (should be DEDICATED_TRIAL). There's an attribute mismatch on the grant object: source=partner-portal, sku_tag=hosted by default.

jae-sre: Logs from the provisioning call:
```
INFO grant_service.apply grant_id=G-9834 tenant=tenant-tilt-9f2 code=TLT-ENTER-42 result=applied
WARN provisioner.queue enqueue_to=dedicated slot_request=1 reason=sku_mismatch
ERROR provisioner.fail reason="sku_mismatch: HOSTED_SKU not compatible with request for DEDICATED"
```

kristen-support: Ok that explains the behavior. Looks like the partner portal mapping for TLT-ENTER-42 is wrong (maps to hosted by default). @devon-billing can you confirm and reissue the grant to Dedicated?

devon-billing: Confirmed. The partner-portal payload omitted "target_sku": "dedicated_trial". I'll revoke the current hosted credit and issue a new grant scoped to DEDICATED_TRIAL. Revoke will remove 1,200 hosted tokens.

til t-corp: Will that interrupt anything if we already used some Hosted tokens? We haven't used any tokens yet — UI said success but we haven't made calls.

devon-billing: Good — no usage to worry about. I'll run:
```
chargebot revoke --grant G-9834 --reason "misrouted to hosted"
chargebot issue --tenant tenant-tilt-9f2 --code TLT-ENTER-42 --sku DEDICATED_TRIAL --amount 1
```
ETA ~20m. @jae-sre can you watch the provisioner and kick a repro if needed once the new grant lands?

jae-sre: Will do. If the provisioner still rejects, I'll manually enqueue a backfill job and attach the dedicated provisioning logs to the ticket.

kristen-support: Workaround in the short term: I enabled hosted-fallback on tenant-tilt-9f2 so they can run quick smoke tests while we fix the grant. Not ideal but keeps them unblocked.

tilt-corp: Appreciated. Please CC our AM when the dedicated slot is ready.

devon-billing: Revoke done, new grant issued: grant=G-9901 target=DEDICATED_TRIAL code=TLT-ENTER-42 :white_check_mark:

jae-sre: Provisioner accepted slot. Provision job id P-5543. Tenant now shows DEDICATED_TRIAL capacity. I'll leave postmortem notes on why partner payload fell back to hosted.

kristen-support: Thanks all — closing loop with the customer now. I'll update the partner onboarding docs to require explicit sku mapping to avoid repeats. :memo:

tilt-corp: Thanks everyone — looks good. :party:
